FN-68SQZZZ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 194
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Rep. Phillip Pettus
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/27/2024
House Bill 194 as introduced would provide that purchases of supplies and services by the
volunteer fire departments and rescue squads would be governed by current state law governing
other local government units. This bill would not otherwise directly affect state or local funding.
